name: Aluminum Vice Jaw Inserts for AN Fitting Assembly
title: Aluminum Vice Jaw Inserts for AN Fitting Assembly
description:
Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, the products are designed for all flavors of motorsports. 



The anodized finish provides an additional layer of protection to ColorFittings products, but using the wrong tools may damage the finish. It is critical to use the correct tools and follow the proper assembly procedure to ensure that the anodized finish is preserved. For this, Color-Fittings strongly advise the usage of the Plastic Vice Jaws during assembly.
